localidad: Laguna #3, Complejo de Lagunas de Sevilla, Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, Ciénaga, Magdalena
comentarios:
UPDATE!... Alex Ossola piece on our paramo expedition and the helmetcrest at risk has just been published at:
[http://undark.org/article/blue-bearded-helmetcrest-colombia-conflict-conservation/](http://undark.org/article/blue-bearded-helmetcrest-colombia-conflict-conservation/)

[Paper spliting the Oxypogon helmetcrest into 4 species here](http://www.proaves.org/wp-content/uploads/2013/12/The-taxonomic-and-conservation-status-of-the-Oxypogon-helmetcrests.pdf)


One female having agonistic interactions with a female Tyrian metaltail (Metallura tyrianthina) in elfin forest near a Libanothamnus sp. patch in between Laguna#2 and Laguna#3


December 2015 expedition to the highlands of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta to look for Blue-bearded Helmetcrest (Oxypogon cyanolaemus)
